preview_status.description: Report the preview tab's state: whether it is available and visible, its tabId, URL, title, loading flag and viewport.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

preview_open.description: Open the collaborative browser preview, optionally at url, and return its status. tabId cannot be combined with reuseExistingTab false.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

url.description: Optional initial page URL, for example https://example.com or localhost:5173. Omit to open a blank tab.

show.description: Whether to reveal the preview panel to the human. Defaults to true.

reuseExistingTab.description: Reuse tabId when supplied, otherwise this agent session's current tab. Defaults to true; set false to create a new tab, which cannot be combined with tabId.

preview_navigate.description: Navigate the preview tab and return its status once it is ready. Give exactly one of url or target; target is {kind:'url', url} or {kind:'environment-port', port, protocol?, path?}.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

url.description: Website URL, for example https://example.com. Use this for public pages and directly reachable URLs.
Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as example.com or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http.

port.description: Dev-server TCP port inside the current environment.

path.description: Optional path, query, and fragment, for example /settings?tab=account.

target.description: Environment-relative target. Prefer {kind:'environment-port',port:5173} for a dev server in the current environment.

readiness.description: Readiness milestone before returning. 'load' is the default; use 'none' only when a later wait call will verify the page.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

preview_resize.description: Resize the preview viewport and return the applied setting and measured viewport. fill takes no other field; freeform needs width and height; preset needs preset and may take orientation.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

mode.description: Viewport mode: fill follows the preview panel, freeform uses exact independently resizable dimensions, and preset uses a named device size.

preset.description: Named device size. Required only when mode is preset.

width.description: Freeform viewport width in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

height.description: Freeform viewport height in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

orientation.description: Orientation for a named device preset. It is not accepted in fill or freeform mode.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

preview_snapshot.description: Snapshot the preview tab: visible text, interactive elements with selectors, console and network entries, and a screenshot as image content. Take one before acting.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

preview_click.description: Click in the preview page. Give exactly one of locator, selector, or the x and y pair.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector such as button[type='submit']. Prefer locator for resilient role/text targeting.

locator.description: Playwright selector, preferably role/text based, for example role=button[name='Send'] or text=Continue. Use snapshot first to inspect the page.

x.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with y.

y.description: Viewport-relative Y coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with x.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

preview_type.description: Type text into the preview page: into locator or selector (at most one), or into the focused element when neither is given.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for the input. Prefer locator.

locator.description: Playwright selector for the input, for example role=textbox[name='Message'] or textarea[placeholder*='Message'].

clear.description: Clear the existing input value before inserting text. Defaults to false.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

preview_press.description: Press one keyboard key in the preview page, with optional modifiers held.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

key.description: Keyboard key name such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Backspace, or a single character.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held while pressing key.

preview_scroll.description: Scroll the preview page, or the container at locator or selector (at most one), by deltaX and/or deltaY. Give at least one delta.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls right. Defaults to 0.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls down. Defaults to 0.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for a scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

locator.description: Playwright selector for a scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

preview_evaluate.description: Run a JavaScript expression in the preview page and return its value. It runs as the page, in the user's preview; prefer preview_snapshot and the action tools.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

expression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the page's main frame, for example document.title or (() => ({href: location.href}))().

awaitPromise.description: Await a returned Promise. Defaults to true.

returnByValue.description: Serialize and return the value instead of a remote object reference. Defaults to true.

preview_wait_for.description: Wait until every given condition holds: locator or selector (at most one), text, urlIncludes. Give at least one. Use it after an action that changes the page asynchronously.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector that must match an element. Prefer locator.

locator.description: Playwright selector that must match an element, for example role=button[name='Send'].

text.description: Case-sensitive substring that must appear in visible document text.

urlIncludes.description: Substring that must appear in the current absolute URL.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

preview_recording_start.description: Start recording the preview tab; returns when the recording began.

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.

preview_recording_stop.description: Stop recording the preview tab and return the recording (id, path, mimeType, size).

tabId.description: Exact collaborative browser tab to target. Omit to use this agent session's current tab.
